name: Verification
result: One script checks lint, unit tests and the real sync, search and eval on a small test folder.

name: Metadata and filters
result: Filters by format, date and folder; dates come from inside each file. Ranking unchanged.

name: Tables, read by an LLM
result: With agent mode on, Claude Haiku reads the top 10 pages and names the page with the answer. Table questions +0.166 nDCG@10 [+0.102, +0.237]; 35 of the 68 questions come from one PDF.

name: Models through an API
result: Embedder and reranker can run on a model server (OpenAI-compatible); results equal the local models.

name: File first, then page
result: Ranking files first loses more right answers than it fixes (28 fixed, 256 lost).

name: Agentic search
result: Rewriting the question and searching again changed nothing (D1); the slide-deck trigger made slides worse (D2).

name: Results display
result: Results grouped by file, snippets around the query's words, a "No confident match" line. Ranking unchanged.

name: Real files, held out
result: A held-out set on a real file collection that is not published. A 34-question LLM draft was easy by construction (the right file first for 27). A 40-question hand-written baseline followed (row F2 in decisions.tsv). Waiting for reviewed questions.

name: Context line per chunk
result: Text files: no gain (held-out +0.018, interval includes 0). Slide images, every slide with a line: right slide first 155 -> 170 of 223 (+enrich only; needs an LLM at index time). Whether to turn it on for slides is not decided (row H2).

name: Search UI
result: A local web page over the same search: grouped results, filters, light and dark themes. The API returns exactly what the command line returns.

name: Entity graph across files
result: A look only, no build and no LLM call: the pooled corpus holds few real links between files, so the question sets cannot judge a graph. Open: drop it, or judge it on files that do link.
